title.prompt:
Edit this K4RMA main menu to feel fuller, more distinctive and more finished while keeping approved clean minimal moonlit hand drawn indie-game style. SAME navy indigo teal palette, simple cel shadows, layered mountain mist, sparse vegetation, exact small black ponytailed hero navy clothing ivory sash katana. Keep readable airy text menu, no new text, no panels or buttons.
Give the TITLE a stronger designed presence: exact "K4RMA" same left upper position, make lettering a little heavier and less hairline, elegant handcrafted serif with subtle taper; slightly increased size about10%, coherent spacing, faint tiny pale moonlight edge. Replace small generic underline with a single refined thin asymmetrical moonlight brush crescent gracefully threading behind/below the logo, subtle enough that letters remain clear, two slender tapering lines, not a big fight slash or halo.
Give right half an architectural focal vignette: reveal more of the original Japanese dojo roof and veranda at right, occupying rightmost25-30%, strong graceful broad roof silhouette, few wooden beams and quiet shoji window with VERY dim warm light. No fancy pagoda ornament, no new trees. Place hero slightly toward center-right lower ground at x64%, standing height13% screen, same identity, calm katana down, ivory sash trailing in breeze, hero facing the misty mountain view. This unifies original world and gives stronger scene storytelling while left menu remains clear. Keep distant roof/waterfall and moon, lower their intensity behind title. Small layered stone footing near dojo side, no foliage increase. Foreground dark architectural silhouettes at extreme bottom corners and gentle floor light create depth, with low blue drifting mist.
Menu texts remain exactly "시작", "이어하기", "설정", "종료" as four vertical plain ivory choices on left-middle; selected 시작 has ONE tiny crescent. Modest brighter selected label, dimmer others. Keep words normal spacing and consistent fine serif. Plenty of negative space around menu. No subtitles, slogans, hints, logos beyond K4RMA, additional menu text or large decorations. Full bleed16:9 screenshot, same clean original art direction, noticeably more polished and rich in composition without busy details.
